featured_reviews.name: Omkar Salunkhe
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve been working out at this gym for the past 3–4 months now and overall, it’s a good space.

That said, I wanted to share a few genuine suggestions that could help improve the experience for members:

1. Communication: If the gym is closed for any reason, informing members via text or WhatsApp would really help. Not everyone checks social media stories before heading to the gym, and many of us travel from far after mentally prepping for a workout.

2. Ventilation & AC: During less crowded hours, often only one AC is switched on, which makes the space quite suffocating. While saving electricity is understandable, members pay for a comfortable workout environment.

3. Lighting & Equipment Downtime: At times, lights are turned off and some equipment remains under maintenance, which limits training options.

Sharing this as a loyal member with the intention that the management can make the experience even better in the future. Hope this feedback is taken positively and worked upon.

Wishing the team a Merry Christmas and a very Happy New Year. Hoping 2026 brings even better facilities and experiences. Cheers!

featured_reviews.review_text:
It's been almost 6 months since I joined Pathare Fitness Centre, and I can confidently say it's been a transformative journey. This place holds a special place in my heart—it has truly changed my life and daily habits for the better.

The gym is well-equipped with top-notch machines and facilities that cater to all fitness levels. The environment is motivating, and the staff is always supportive and helpful. Pathare Fitness has played a major role in helping me overcome personal hurdles related to fitness, discipline, mental peace, and overall lifestyle.

I also enrolled in personal training with Gautam Handa, and that decision has been a game-changer. He helped me achieve fat loss, build strength and muscle, and guided me holistically with nutrition and lifestyle tips. Gautam is genuinely a gem of a trainer—his dedication, knowledge, and constant support (even outside training hours via calls and messages) made a huge difference. Even after my personal training period ended, he continues to guide and motivate me, which shows how invested he is in his clients' growth.

If you're serious about your fitness goals, I highly recommend training under Gautam Handa and becoming a part of the Pathare Fitness community. Trust me, it's absolutely worth it.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I have recently embarked on a one-month trial membership at a local gym, with the intention of assessing its suitability for my fitness needs. Regrettably, my experience thus far has been somewhat underwhelming.

Upon observation, it appears that the gym staff tends to devote a disproportionate amount of attention to female clients, often neglecting the needs of male patrons such as myself. Furthermore, I have found that the staff fails to provide adequate guidance and support during training sessions, which is a crucial aspect of ensuring a safe and effective workout.

Additionally, the gym becomes exceedingly congested during peak hours, rendering it challenging to access equipment and machinery in a timely manner. This overcrowding issue not only hinders my ability to maintain a consistent workout routine but also creates an unpleasant atmosphere that detracts from my overall gym experience.

In light of these shortcomings, I am compelled to reevaluate my decision to continue my membership beyond the trial period. It is essential for a gym to provide a supportive environment, personalized attention, and adequate resources to facilitate a productive and enjoyable workout experience. Unfortunately, my current gym falls short of meeting these expectations.
